about_the_game:
Road 7 is an infinite arcade-style racing game where you navigate through various zones, dodging obstacles in classic mode or cruising freely in peaceful mode. With five difficulty levels, it accommodates all skill levels. Occasionally, you'll encounter anomalous zones with unpredictable events or hybrid zones blending elements from different environments.

Game modes:

  • Classic - The intended Road 7 experience. Drive endlessly until you can drive no longer.

  • Peaceful - Drive to your heart's content without any obstacles getting in your way. This mode is best for beginners or those who just want a relaxing experience.

  • Custom - Want to spice things up? Mess around with different settings to tailor the game to YOU.

Environments Include:

  • Grasslands

  • Farm

  • Desert

  • Tundra

  • Beach

  • Graveyard

  • Asteroid Field

  • Coral Reef

  • Plus more+

Minimum:
  • OS: WIndows 10, Windows 11

  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

  • VR Support: Not Supported
